page_title: PAR 2-1 TOR | Parma v Torino 29/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90+3' Adrien Tameze (Torino) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Giuseppe Collu stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
90+2' Alieu Njie (Torino) picks up a yellow card.
90+1' Substitution. Milan Djuric (Parma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mateo Pellegrino walks off.
90+1' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+1' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by Torino is thwarted by the well prepared Zion Suzuki (Parma).

89' Alieu Njie (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
89' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
87' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Giovanni Simeone is replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
87' Here's the change. Nikola Vlasic leaves the pitch and Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
86' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
82' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
82' Alessandro Circati (Parma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Torino are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
81' Substitution. Patrick Cutrone leaves the pitch and is replaced by Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
81' Carlos Cuesta has decided to substitute Adrian Bernabe Garcia and he is replaced by Nahuel Estevez (Parma).
78' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle as Cyril Ngonge (Torino) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
77' Che Adams comes onto the pitch because Ardian Ismajli (Torino) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
77' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
76' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
75' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
72' 2 - 1 GOAL! The corner is whipped in and Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
72' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
72' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' Marco Baroni has decided to make a change. Adrien Tameze (Torino) replaces Kristjan Asllani.
70' Substitution. Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) has come on for Niels Nkounkou.
69' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
68' A yellow card for bad language! Niels Nkounkou (Torino) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
68' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul after Saul Coco (Torino) hacks down one of his opponents. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
67' The ratio of the ball possession is 39:61.
66' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
65' Giovanni Simeone receives a short pass from Cyril Ngonge (Torino), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.

64' Mandela Keita (Parma) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
62' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
61' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt is neither hard nor precise, so Zion Suzuki stops it easily.
60' This is a yellow card! Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
59' Good defending. Cyril Ngonge (Torino) tries to find Giovanni Simeone inside the box, but the pass is cut out. It's a throw-in for Torino.

58' Cesare Casadei (Torino) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Zion Suzuki!
58' It is time for a substitution. Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) is on for Gaetano Oristanio.

57' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
56' Parma fail to score from a corner as Franco Israel (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.
55' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
51' Cesare Casadei (Torino) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
50' Marco Baroni is stunned as referee Giuseppe Collu shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
50' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Cyril Ngonge (Torino). He perfectly collected a pass from Saul Coco, then unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the left post. The score is 1:1.
47' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
46' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul. Parma have been awarded a free kick.
45+2' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) tries to find Enrico Del Prato, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

43' What a poor attempt! Kristjan Asllani (Torino) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.

41' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

39' Zion Suzuki (Parma) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Torino.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Franco Israel gets a hand on the penalty from Mateo Pellegrino (Parma), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
35' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
35' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
34' Referee Giuseppe Collu makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
32' That looked a certain handball by Ardian Ismajli (Torino) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

32' There's a distinct lack of options for Gaetano Oristanio (Parma), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
30' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
29' This shall not pass! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Torino.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 0:6.
25' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Zion Suzuki comes off his line to gather the ball.

24' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.

22' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Zion Suzuki pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
21' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
20' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
19' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.

17' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
16' Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
14' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
13' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) sprays a pass out to Cyril Ngonge, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
10' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Torino.
8' Zion Suzuki (Parma) sends a long cross over to Mateo Pellegrino, but Franco Israel comes forward to gather the ball.
5' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) passes the ball onto Giovanni Simeone, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
4' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from Parma. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu will referee today's match.
